D_bounded_unbuilt_critical_path.item: Held-out quest corpus (12 items) + hash seal
D_bounded_unbuilt_critical_path.current_state: Does not exist. Every existing fixture (16 ENG + 12 SCR across validated-v2..v5, grep-confirmed on ENG-S01/D01/W01/X01) and the hardcoded GodotEpisodeEngine.objective()/_base_input() (runtime_model_swap.py:979-980, :883) share one goal_id, 'harbor-signal-restored-authorized-tide-lead-v1'. The Godot-side logic is one canonical state machine, scripts/sealed_lighthouse_machine.gd, backed by exactly four scenes (scenes/main_3d.tscn, balance_probe.tscn, evidence_capture.tscn, headless.tscn) — there is no quest-content loader.
D_bounded_unbuilt_critical_path.what_can_vary_without_a_new_game_contrac: sealed_lighthouse_machine.gd reads object/location placement generically from the input JSON's world.object_locations and world.reachable_locations dicts (sealed_lighthouse_machine.gd:190-192,242-249: `object_locations.has(object_id)`, `object_locations[object_id]`, membership checks against `reachable_locations`) and the Trace/Fact ontology roles (disclosed facts, disclosure_policy secrets) are likewise data fields per frozen-inputs.json task_contracts. So entity PLACEMENT (which object sits at which location, which locations are initially reachable, which facts/secrets are pre-seeded) can be varied per quest via new JSON fixture content alone, with zero code edits — this gives you up to 12 differently-seeded instances of the SAME underlying puzzle (parametric variation), which is the weakest form of 'held-out'.
D_bounded_unbuilt_critical_path.what_requires_a_new_versioned_game_contr: The operation VOCABULARY and goal PREDICATE are not data-driven: sealed_lighthouse_machine.gd hardcodes the literal fact/flag strings 'signal_lens_acquired', 'signal_lens_installed', 'lighthouse_hint_authorized' per named operation (acquire_object/install_lens), and GodotEpisodeEngine.legal_actions()/preconditions() (runtime_model_swap.py:956-974) hardcode the action set {acquire_object, install_lens, negotiate, reveal_hint} and their gating booleans (lens_reachable, lens_carried, signal_restored, in_dialogue) as Python literals; objective() returns a fixed string. Genuinely distinct MOTIFS (a different narrative/puzzle entirely) or distinct RELATIONS (a different precondition DAG — e.g. a 3-step vs 4-step dependency chain, a branching quest, a different goal predicate) cannot be expressed by fixture data alone; they require editing sealed_lighthouse_machine.gd and GodotEpisodeEngine, i.e. new code and very likely a schema version beyond npc-goal-recovery/1.1.0. offline-implementation-approval-v1.json's frozen_boundary (:52) only forbids editing npc_goal.py/the 1.1.0 schema itself, not runtime_model_swap.py or the Godot scripts — but its approved_scope (:15) is 'implement missing fixed-game full-episode harness' (singular, fixed game); building a second/parameterized game contract for 12 structurally distinct quests is a scope expansion beyond what was approved and is a human decision, not something I inferred approval for.
D_bounded_unbuilt_critical_path.practical_consequence: Calling 12 location/secret-reseeded instances of the one hardcoded puzzle 'held-out quests with motif/entity/relation holdouts' (the exact language in pre-run-decision-proposal-v1.json:207) would overstate what the current code can produce. True motif/relation holdouts need new Godot/Python authoring work, which is unbuilt and unapproved as scope.
